summary: Shared utilities for handling CLI hook input ingestion, validation, and ping orchestration.
responsibilities: Provide reusable logic for parsing and validating JSON-formatted hook inputs from stdin.
Orchestrate agent heartbeat signals (pings) within a defined runtime environment.
Implement dry-run support for hook executions by allowing stdin fallbacks and silent output redirection.
Manage CLI runtime context adjustments including CWD and stdout suppression.

symbols.name: HookRuntimeOptions
symbols.summary: Configuration options for hook execution lifecycle, emphasizing dry-run capabilities.

symbols.name: parseJsonHookInput
symbols.summary: Reads stdin, validates JSON against a Zod schema, and manages fallback scenarios.

symbols.name: sendHookPing
symbols.summary: Sends a ping command to the agent using the provided hook runtime parameters.
